# Kinetic Icons (`kinetic-ui-icons`) — Complete Technical Reference for LLMs & Search Engines

> Kinetic Icons is an open-source, MIT-licensed ($0 free forever) multi-framework SVG icon library containing 462 original monoline icons on a 24x24 optical grid. Every icon uses continuous-curvature cubic Bezier corner math so stroke weight (0.75–3.5px) and corner radius (0.0–4.0px) can be tuned smoothly without silhouette distortion.

## Package & Distribution
- **Website**: https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/
- **Creator**: Neer (https://framesbyneer.in)
- **Install**: `npm install kinetic-ui-icons` (also works with `pnpm add kinetic-ui-icons`, `yarn add kinetic-ui-icons`)
- **CDN**: `https://esm.sh/kinetic-ui-icons/web`
- **Subpath Exports**:
  - `kinetic-ui-icons/react` — Tree-shakeable `React.forwardRef` PascalCase components (zero client hooks, Next.js App Router RSC safe)
  - `kinetic-ui-icons/web` — `<kinetic-icon>` Web Component and `createIcons()` helper for Vanilla JS, HTML, Vue, Svelte, Astro
  - `kinetic-ui-icons/core` (also default `.`) — Zero-dependency pure TypeScript geometry engine, named `*Icon` definitions, and `renderIconSvg()`
  - `flutter/lib/kinetic_icons.dart` — Ready-to-paste Dart library for `flutter_svg`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/neerxj789/kinetic-icons
- **License**: MIT License — free forever for personal, open-source, and commercial applications with no attribution required.

## React & Next.js API (`kinetic-ui-icons/react`)
Every kebab-case icon ID maps to a PascalCase React component (e.g., `shield-check` -> `ShieldCheck`, `map-add` -> `MapAdd`, `ai-spark` -> `AiSpark`).

### Props
- `size?: number | string` (default `24`) — Width and height in px or CSS unit.
- `strokeWidth?: number | string` (default `1.5`) — Recommended range `1.0` to `2.5`.
- `radius?: number` (default `2.5`) — `0` for sharp (`square`/`miter`) up to `4.0` for soft continuous-curvature rounded (`round`/`round`).
- `color?: string` (default `"currentColor"`) — Explicit hex/RGB/CSS color or inherits CSS/Tailwind `text-*` color.
- `...rest: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>` — `className`, `style`, `ref`, `aria-label`, `onClick`, etc.

### Example
```tsx
import { Home, ShieldCheck, Carousel, Verified } from 'kinetic-ui-icons/react';

export default function Toolbar() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">
      <Home size={20} />
      <ShieldCheck size={20} strokeWidth={1.75} radius={2.5} className="text-emerald-600" />
      <Carousel size={20} radius={3} />
      <Verified size={20} color="#2563EB" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Web Component & HTML API (`kinetic-ui-icons/web`)
```html
<kinetic-icon name="shield-check" size="24" stroke="1.5" radius="2.5" color="#2563EB"></kinetic-icon>
<i data-kinetic="home" data-size="24" data-stroke="1.5" data-radius="2.5"></i>
<script type="module">
  import { createIcons } from 'kinetic-ui-icons/web';
  createIcons();
</script>
```

## Core TypeScript API (`kinetic-ui-icons/core`)
```ts
import { homeIcon, renderIconSvg } from 'kinetic-ui-icons/core';

const svgMarkup = renderIconSvg(homeIcon, {
  size: 24,
  stroke: 1.5,
  radius: 2.5,
  color: '#111113',
});
```

## Flutter API (`flutter_svg`)
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:kinetic_icons/kinetic_icons.dart';

const KineticIcon(KineticIcons.home, size: 24);
const KineticIcon(KineticIcons.verified, size: 24, color: Color(0xFF2563EB));
```

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO)
- **Is Kinetic Icons free for commercial use?** Yes. All 462 icons and wrappers are MIT-licensed and $0 free forever for personal, client, SaaS, and commercial apps with no attribution required.
- **How do I change icon colors?** Icons default to `stroke="currentColor"` so they inherit CSS/Tailwind text color or Flutter `IconTheme`. You can also pass an explicit `color` prop/attribute directly on any icon.
- **Does Kinetic Icons work in Next.js Server Components?** Yes. Components in `kinetic-ui-icons/react` use zero client hooks or runtime state and render directly in Next.js App Router Server Components.
- **How does Kinetic keep rounded corners sharp and legible?** Kinetic calculates continuous-curvature cubic Bezier fillets (`k = 0.58`) per vertex with angle compensation and segment clamping so silhouettes stay recognizable from `radius=0` to `radius=4.0`.
